title: Home - Lancia Motor Club
description: The Lancia Motor Club was founded in 1947 and is dedicated to encouraging the use and preservation of all Lancia models from 1906 to date. You are welcome to browse and see what the Lancia Motor Club has to offer to you as a Lancia owner or enthusiast.If you wish to join the oldest and largest club dedicated to the Lancia marque, then you can join securely online
